description: Evaluation set. `expected_source: null` marks intentionally out-of-document questions (the correct behaviour is web fallback or an honest refusal).

questions.question: What is the main problem this document addresses?
Which method or approach does the paper propose?
What datasets or data were used?
What are the reported results or key metrics?
Who are the authors or contributors?
What does the architecture diagram show?
Summarize the conclusion in one sentence.
What baseline is the method compared against?
What is the current price of Bitcoin today?
Who won the most recent FIFA World Cup?
What is the capital of Australia?
What are the side effects of ibuprofen?
What is the tallest mountain on Earth?
